acceptance: Every TPC-Havoc variant rendered for presto (220 variants plus 22 canonical queries) executes on a live PrestoDB 0.298.1 server over tpch.tiny and is compared with DuckDB, with the outcome of each id recorded as durable evidence
The Presto C++ REDUCE input cap is measured on a native worker against the rendered 1_v7, with the engine error text, the boundary, and the session-property behaviour recorded as durable evidence
Variants that do not match are enumerated with the engine output and the cause or the reason it is unknown
